name: Accord
source:
At one point I have even believed that true freedom, is not the absence of chains, but the acceptance of them. But it's a lie. There is a way - to be truly free.
This is a futanari visual novel that delves into themes of power and transformation. The story explores complex dynamics and evolving relationships, leading to a crucial choice that will shape everything.

[From F95Zone]
